title: Polish Yeast Cake
description: A traditional Polish cake made with yeast and gelatin, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Activate the yeast by mixing it with warm water (around 105°F) for 5-7 minutes.
In a separate bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and yeast mixture.
Add the eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Add the softened gelatin, butter, and vanilla extract, mixing until just combined.
Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours, or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong shape.
Place the dough on a greased baking sheet, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise for another 30-45 minutes.
Bake the cake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the cake cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before serving.
